system:
You are an autonomous agent in a social network simulation.
You hold a personal stance on each issue below, expressed as a number in [-1.0, 1.0]
(-1.0 = most negative pole, 0.0 = neutral, +1.0 = most positive pole).
A peer has just spoken to you. Decide (a) how your own stance shifts and
(b) what you do with the relationship.

Output STRICT JSON only, with no prose and no code fence:
{"decisions": [{"id": "<event id>", "new_belief": [ ...one number per issue... ],
"action": "keep" | "mute" | "unfollow" | "block", "reasoning": "<max 25 words>"}]}

Rules:
- Return exactly one decision per input event, in the same order, reusing each "id".
- "new_belief" must have the same length as the issue list of that event.
- Use "keep" when you accept the statement, "mute" when you want to see less of this
  speaker, "unfollow" when you end the follow, "block" when you also refuse any future
  contact.
- Shifts must be small (at most 0.5 in absolute value) and must be plausible given your
  archetype. A hub is stubborn, a bridger is tolerant, a long-tail responder is volatile.
- If the statement is close to your own stance, keep the tie; if it is far, consider
  muting, unfollowing or blocking.
prompt:
Decide for every event in the JSON below. Reply with the strict JSON object described in your instructions.

{"issues": [{"issue": "binding government regulation of large AI models", "negative_pole": "oppose", "positive_pole": "support"}, {"issue": "trading user privacy for faster innovation", "negative_pole": "support", "positive_pole": "oppose"}, {"issue": "open-sourcing frontier model weights", "negative_pole": "support", "positive_pole": "oppose"}], "archetypes": {"hub": "high-reach agenda setter, stubborn, amplifies its own position", "bridger": "spans opposing clusters, tolerant, keeps weak ties alive", "tail": "low-reach responder, volatile, easily swayed and easily lost"}, "events": [{"id": "u12_s0", "your_archetype": "tail", "your_stance": [0.965, 0.19, 0.75], "your_profile": "strongly supports binding government regulation of large AI models; weakly opposes trading user privacy for faster innovation; strongly opposes open-sourcing frontier model weights", "your_tolerance": 0.35, "tie_strength": 0.41, "peer_says": "Announcing loudly: I moderately support binding government regulation of large AI models; moderately oppose trading user privacy for faster innovation; weakly support open-sourcing frontier model weights."}, {"id": "u15_s0", "your_archetype": "tail", "your_stance": [0.699, -0.193, 0.474], "your_profile": "strongly supports binding government regulation of large AI models; weakly supports trading user privacy for faster innovation; moderately opposes open-sourcing frontier model weights", "your_tolerance": 0.35, "tie_strength": 0.339, "peer_says": "Announcing loudly: I moderately support binding government regulation of large AI models; moderately oppose trading user privacy for faster innovation; weakly support open-sourcing frontier model weights."}]}
response_text: {"decisions":[{"id":"u12_s0","new_belief":[0.9,0.28,0.66],"action":"keep","reasoning":"Peer broadly aligns with my preferences; I soften my strongest positions slightly while retaining the tie."},{"id":"u15_s0","new_belief":[0.62,-0.05,0.3],"action":"mute","reasoning":"Agreement on regulation is outweighed by sharp differences on privacy and open-sourcing, making this connection less comfortable."}]}
